title: The Galaxy (centre to Periphery)
description: Worlds of the Foundation novels by the region their sources name, linked to the books set there.

regions.label: Between the centre and the Periphery

galaxy.note: Drawn by TimeLiner from data, not a map image. The novels give no coordinates, only regions: each world sits on the ring of the region its source names (the centre or the Periphery). The rings' widths and a world's position round its ring mean nothing; worlds whose sources name no region are not shown.

credit.title: Asimov Wiki planet articles; Wikipedia: Foundation (Asimov novel)
credit.author: Asimov Wiki and Wikipedia contributors
credit.note: Regions and books are read from each world's article (revision linked from the place). No map image is used.

places.name: Terminus
places.note: Asimov Wiki: "It is the capital planet of the First Foundation, located at the edge of the Galaxy." (source linked below). Wikipedia: Foundation (Asimov novel): "the Encyclopedia Foundation, tasked with preserving the Empire's knowledge, is established on the mineral-poor agricultural planet Terminus".

places.name: Anacreon
places.note: Asimov Wiki: "Anacreon (also known as Anacreon A II) is a planet near the outer end of the Periphery" (source linked below). Wikipedia: Foundation (Asimov novel): "During a visit of the Foundation's Mayor Hardin to the kingdom of Anacreon".

places.name: Trantor
places.note: Asimov Wiki: "It is an ecumenopolis world near the galactic core" (source linked below). Asimov Wiki: Trantor: infobox sources "Prelude to Foundation, Foundation, Second Foundation". Asimov Wiki: Trantor: infobox sources "Prelude to Foundation, Foundation, Second Foundation". Asimov Wiki: Trantor: infobox sources "Prelude to Foundation, Foundation, Second Foundation".

places.name: Neotrantor
places.note: Asimov Wiki: "a small agricultural planet located near the center of the galaxy, near Trantor" (source linked below). Asimov Wiki: Neotrantor: "In Foundation and Empire, Toran and Bayta Darell, Ebling Mis, and the Mule visit Neotrantor".
